reconcile.note: Henry treats the veil's tearing as happening at the very moment Jesus died, so the Gospels record one simultaneous event rather than a strict before-and-after sequence.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Bart D. Ehrman catalogues this as a contradiction, but the project's public-domain source survey found no verbatim critic passage that engages it.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Bart D. Ehrman, Jesus, Interrupted: Revealing the Hidden Contradictions in the Bible (And Why We Don't Know About Them) (2009).
